themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals that provide digital connectivity, online or assisted access to city services, or public access to civic information and data.

themes.name: Housing Affordability and Quality
themes.rule: Proposals that increase housing supply or affordability, improve residential buildings, or make housing-market information more transparent.

themes.name: Public Safety and Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime or improve emergency response, including non-traffic safety measures in public spaces.

themes.name: Public and Active Transport
themes.rule: Proposals that improve bus service, transit affordability or rider information, cycling infrastructure, or traffic safety for people moving around the city.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical, mental-health, preventive-health, or in-home care services.

themes.name: Schools and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve school facilities, staffing, classroom learning, student meals, or educational enrichment and tutoring.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce pollution, waste, or energy use, or support urban ecology through measures such as trees, gardens, monitoring, recycling, composting, or plastic reduction.

themes.name: Culture, Recreation, and Public Spaces
themes.rule: Proposals that expand cultural access and events or create neighborhood recreational, gathering, and play spaces, rather than environmental infrastructure.

themes.name: Local Economic Opportunity
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers, job training, local hiring, small businesses, coworking, business finance, or business licensing.
